titulo: Man found dead in Queensland flood waters as state hit by multiple storms and days-long deluge
cuerpo: Many rivers and roads left flooded after torrential downpours across Queensland Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A man’s body has been found in flood waters following an unusual weather system that delivered multiple storms and a days-long deluge to parts of Australia. Emergency services were called to a creek at Boompa on Queensland’s Fraser Coast shortly after 11am on Monday after reports a man had been found unresponsive. Continue reading...
